slides.title: Leaving Ethiopia by sea: the Eastern Route
slides.body: Explainer: IOM data via UN News, Oct 2026

slides.title: journeys from Ethiopia into Djibouti
slides.body: Recorded by IOM from Sept 10 to early October 2026, with migrants heading for Yemen.

slides.title: migrants seen stranded in Djibouti
slides.body: Along migration routes, Sept 20-30, IOM said. It also received reports of deaths in the desert near the Ethiopian border.

slides.title: arrivals in Yemen, Jan-Apr 2026
slides.body: On the Horn of Africa Eastern Route, up 9 per cent, according to IOM data.

slides.title: dead in one shipwreck off Obock
slides.body: 305 people were aboard when the boat sank on Oct 9. IOM said 84 remained missing.

slides.title: Safe options and protection for migrants save lives.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: IOM via UN News, Oct 6 & 11, 2026; IOM, Aug 12, 2026
